hero.title: Inventory, sales, and operations in one place.
hero.subtitle: Ohnix centralizes products, stock, purchases, orders, and reports so your team controls every movement with clarity—without spreadsheets or disconnected tools.

about.title: Built for teams that live by their inventory.
about.description: Ohnix is an operations platform that connects catalog, stock entries, sales, and analytics so small and mid-sized businesses run with fewer errors and faster decisions.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Make inventory control simple and reliable.
mission.description: Every product, quantity, and transaction should be easy to register, audit, and act on from a single workspace.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: Operations that scale without losing precision.
vision.description: We want teams to grow volume and complexity while keeping stock accurate and processes consistent.

connected.title: Connected data
connected.description: Purchases, sales, and catalog stay in sync so stock always reflects reality.

sustainable.title: Operational clarity
sustainable.description: Clear states, permissions, and history reduce guesswork across the team.

precise.title: Accurate stock
precise.description: Atomic updates and validations help prevent overselling and silent discrepancies.

solutions.title: Everything you need to run inventory day to day.
solutions.description: Modular tools that work together: configure your catalog, move stock in and out, and measure performance from one dashboard.

lifecycle.title: Products & catalog
lifecycle.description: Manage SKUs, categories, units, prices, and images—including bulk import from CSV.

assets.title: Purchases & stock in
assets.description: Register supplier purchases, track statuses, and increase stock with full traceability.

sustainability.title: Sales & orders
sustainability.description: Create orders, deduct inventory safely, and export professional invoice PDFs.

circular.title: Reports & alerts
circular.description: Monitor sales, purchases, and low-stock signals to decide before problems appear.

timeline.title: From setup to insight in four steps.
timeline.description: A practical flow that matches how teams actually operate: organize the catalog, receive goods, sell, and review results.

observe.title: Organize your catalog
observe.description: Add products, categories, customers, and suppliers—the foundation for accurate stock.

connect.title: Register purchases
connect.description: Record incoming merchandise and update quantities with validated stock movements.

optimize.title: Fulfill sales
optimize.description: Issue orders, apply secure stock deductions, and share invoices with your customers.

regenerate.title: Review & improve
regenerate.description: Use dashboards and reports to spot trends, low stock, and opportunities to optimize.

impact.title: Operational gains you can feel in daily work.
impact.description: Ohnix is designed to reduce manual tracking and give teams a shared source of truth for inventory and sales.

uptime.label: Access
uptime.description: Work from the cloud whenever your business needs it.

recovery.label: Unified ops
recovery.description: Purchases, sales, and catalog in one connected flow.

optimization.label: Manual work
optimization.description: Automated alerts, PDFs, and structured workflows replace ad-hoc spreadsheets.

adoption.label: Team control
adoption.description: Roles and verified accounts keep data scoped to the right people.

testimonials.title: Trusted by operators who need control, not complexity.
testimonials.description: Examples of how businesses use Ohnix to keep inventory accurate and sales moving.

first.name: Warehouse Manager
first.content: We finally see the same stock numbers in the office and on the floor. Purchases and sales stay aligned without duplicate entries.

second.name: Store Owner
second.content: Low-stock alerts and quick reports saved us from repeated outages. Invoicing from orders alone cut hours each week.

third.name: Operations Lead
third.content: Onboarding the team was straightforward: products, suppliers, and orders in one panel with clear permissions.

partners.title: Built for businesses that move physical goods.
partners.description: Retail, wholesale, workshops, and growing teams that need reliable inventory without enterprise overhead.

faq.title: Common questions about Ohnix
faq.description: Quick answers about what the platform does and how to get started.

first.question: What is Ohnix?
first.answer: Ohnix is an inventory and operations platform by iTcycle. It helps you manage products, stock, purchases, sales orders, customers, suppliers, and reports from one place.

second.question: Does it support purchases and sales?
second.answer: Yes. You can register purchases to increase stock, create sales orders with safe stock deductions, handle returns where applicable, and generate invoice PDFs.

third.question: Can I import many products at once?
third.answer: Yes. The product module supports bulk upload via CSV so you can migrate or expand your catalog faster.

fourth.question: How do I get started?
fourth.answer: Create an account with the primary button, verify your email, and explore the demo video to see the dashboard, products, and order flows in action.

contact.title: Ready to control your inventory?
contact.description: Create your account in minutes or watch the demo to see purchases, sales, and reporting workflows.
contact.signal_description: Questions about setup, migrations, or team access? We typically respond within one business day.
